telemetry.title: Telemetry and diagnostic data
telemetry.description: Turns off diagnostic data, activity history and app-launch tracking.

suggestions.title: Suggestions and ads
suggestions.description: Turns off suggestions, tips and ads across Windows.

bing.title: Bing and Copilot in Search
bing.description: Turns off web results in Windows Search.

location.title: Location services
location.description: Turns off Windows location services and app location access.

findmydevice.title: Find My Device
findmydevice.description: Stops sending location data to Microsoft.

activity_history.title: Activity history
activity_history.description: Turns off activity history and app-launch tracking.

recall.title: Windows Recall
recall.description: Turns off Recall, which records screen history.

ai_svc.title: AI service auto-start
ai_svc.description: Prevents the WSAIFabricSvc service from starting automatically.

edge_ai.title: Edge AI features
edge_ai.description: Turns off the AI sidebar and Copilot features in Edge.

edge_ads.title: Edge ads and MSN feed
edge_ads.description: Turns off ads, suggestions and the news feed in Edge.

paint_ai.title: Paint AI
paint_ai.description: Turns off image generation tools in Paint.

notepad_ai.title: Notepad AI
notepad_ai.description: Turns off writing suggestions in Notepad.

chrome_ai.title: Chrome AI
chrome_ai.description: Turns off Gemini and AI features in Chrome.

brave_bloat.title: Brave extras
brave_bloat.description: Turns off AI, crypto, news and VPN features in Brave.

dark_mode.title: Dark theme
dark_mode.description: Enables dark theme for the system and apps.

transparency.title: Disable transparency effects
transparency.description: Turns off transparency; speeds up older hardware.

animations.title: Disable animations
animations.description: Turns off UI animations for a snappier feel.

context_menu.title: Classic context menu
context_menu.description: Restores the Windows 10 style right-click menu.

sticky_keys.title: Sticky Keys shortcut
sticky_keys.description: Turns off the dialog shown when pressing Shift 5 times.

file_ext.title: Show file extensions
file_ext.description: Shows extensions for known file types.

hidden_files.title: Show hidden files
hidden_files.description: Makes hidden files and folders visible.

hide_gallery.title: Hide Gallery section
hide_gallery.description: Removes Gallery from the navigation pane.

hide_home.title: Hide Home section
hide_home.description: Removes Home from the navigation pane.

hide_onedrive.title: Hide OneDrive section
hide_onedrive.description: Removes OneDrive from the navigation pane.

add_folders.title: Add folders to This PC
add_folders.description: Adds Desktop, Documents, Downloads and more.

hide_taskview.title: Hide Task View button
hide_taskview.description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar.

hide_search.title: Hide search box
hide_search.description: Removes the search box from the taskbar.

widgets.title: Disable widgets
widgets.description: Turns off taskbar and lock screen widgets.

end_task.title: 'End task' in taskbar
end_task.description: Adds end-task to the right-click menu.

last_active_click.title: Switch to last active window
last_active_click.description: Taskbar click switches to the last active window.

start_recommended.title: Hide Start recommendations
start_recommended.description: Turns off the recommended section in the Start menu.

start_phone_link.title: Phone Link in Start
start_phone_link.description: Removes the phone integration from the Start menu.

clear_start.title: Clear pinned apps
clear_start.description: Removes pinned apps from the Start menu.

delivery_optimization.title: Delivery Optimization sharing
delivery_optimization.description: Turns off sharing updates with other PCs.

driver_updates.title: Disable driver updates
driver_updates.description: Blocks driver updates via Windows Update.

prevent_reboot.title: Block automatic restart
prevent_reboot.description: Prevents automatic restart after updates while signed in.

update_asap.title: Don't get updates first
update_asap.description: Stops getting new feature updates early.

fast_startup.title: Disable fast startup
fast_startup.description: Ensures a full shutdown; fixes some issues.

gamebar.title: Xbox Game Bar integration
gamebar.description: Turns off game bar integration and recording.

notifications.title: Windows notifications
notifications.description: Turns off system and app notifications.

settings_home.title: Remove Settings home
settings_home.description: Hides the home page in the Settings app.

settings_ads.title: Microsoft 365 ads in Settings
settings_ads.description: Turns off Microsoft 365 ads on the Settings home page.

store_suggestions.title: Store search suggestions
store_suggestions.description: Turns off Store app suggestions in search.

standby_net.title: Network during modern standby
standby_net.description: Turns off network in sleep mode; saves battery.
